text_blocks.snippet: Common and serious side effects of Jardiance (empagliflozin) can range from mild irritations to medical emergencies.

list.snippet: Urinary tract infections (UTIs): Symptoms include a burning sensation when you pee, an urgent need to urinate, frequent urination, or cloudy/discolored urine.
Genital yeast infections: These can affect women (vaginal itching, burning, thick white discharge) and men (itching or redness around the penis or scrotum) due to extra sugar in the urine.
Increased urination: You will naturally need to pee more often as the medication flushes excess glucose out of your body.

Diabetic ketoacidosis (DKA): A life-threatening buildup of acid and ketones in the blood—even when blood sugar isn't extremely high. Symptoms include nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, unusual fatigue, trouble breathing, or fruity-smelling breath.
Dehydration and low blood pressure: Losing water and salt can make you feel dizzy, faint, lightheaded, or weak, especially when standing up.

Necrotizing fasciitis (Fournier’s gangrene): A rare but severe and potentially fatal bacterial infection of the tissue between the anus and genitals, causing intense pain, swelling, redness, and fever.
Low blood sugar (hypoglycemia): More likely if you take Jardiance alongside other diabetes medications like insulin or sulfonylureas.
Lower limb amputations: SGLT2 inhibitors have been associated with an increased risk of toe, foot, or leg amputations, particularly in people with a history of vascular disease or foot ulcers.
Severe allergic reactions: Swelling of the face, lips, throat, or tongue, trouble breathing or swallowing, or widespread hives.

text_blocks.snippet: For detailed product safety information, consult the Jardiance Official Site or talk to your prescribing doctor or pharmacist.
